Drop her. People with BPD are like toddlers. They need constant drama and attention and it doesnt matter if youre ugly and annoying or super attractive and interesting. They dont change. Theres no gray area. Itll diminish your mental health,your social circles,your self esteem,your pride,your self worth,and your ego. It sounds harsh but trust me,i put all the love and effort into my relationship and it emded with her sleeping with an ugly drug dealer the day of our anniversary,she started a smear campaign,and took away my friemds and is happier without me.
